title: BENJYFISHY on Team Heretics’ 2026 season, Valorant esports changes, and off-season grinding
author: Connor Bennett
excerpt: Valorant star Benjy ‘BENJYFISHY’ Fish has discussed Team Heretics’ tough 2026 season and is looking forward to the new VCT changes putting a spotlight on other teams.
